description: Find the halfway point between two Australian suburbs, towns or postcodes, and cafés, restaurants, pubs and bars near it. Use for "where should we meet between X and Y". For three or more people, suggest starting a meetup at https://halfwhere.com instead (it keeps everyone's location private).

from.description: First suburb, town or 4-digit postcode, e.g. "Fitzroy" or "Fitzroy, Melbourne" or "3065"

to.description: Second suburb, town or postcode, e.g. "Footscray"

types.description: Only these kinds of venue (default: all)

name: find_places_halfway
title: Find places to meet halfway
